ingredients.name: peanut oil, or other suitable frying oil

steps.instruction: Soak 10 ounces of precooked noodles in hot water for 2 minutes.
steps.spoken: Loosen 10 ounces of precooked thick wheat noodles in a bowl of hot water for 2 to three minutes.

steps.instruction: Drain the noodles and set them aside.
Mix 3 tablespoons of soy sauce and 2 tablespoons of oyster sauce in a bowl.
Mix in 2 teaspoons of sesame oil and 2 tablespoons of water.
Heat 2 tablespoons of peanut oil in a wok or large pan over high heat.
Add 1 carrot, cut into thin sticks, and 2 cups of broccoli florets.
steps.spoken: Add the carrot and the broccoli florets. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 6 ounces of firm tofu, cut into cubes.
steps.spoken: Add the tofu cubes. Stir-fry for 4 minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and 2 teaspoons of grated ginger.
steps.spoken: Add the garlic and the ginger. Stir-fry for 1 minute.

steps.instruction: Stir in the noodles, the sauce and 1/2 cup of roasted cashews.
steps.spoken: Stir in the noodles, then the sauce and 1/2 cup of roasted cashews. Mix until everything is thoroughly combined and heated through.
